_fixture.source: isolated-server answer: GET on an isolated `pitwall serve` (127.0.0.1:8904, scratch data dir, LLM and voice off, UDP on 127.0.0.1:20904 with no game) from the feat/controls worktree while the backend was in progress, after the dashboard saved the recommended F1 25 PS5 layout for the GT DD Pro template. Not a live rig.

assignments.label: Talk to Pitwall
assignments.reason: Talk to Pitwall on Triangle: a plain button you can hold with your thumb. Map it to UDP Action 1 in F1 25 so Pitwall sees it.
warnings: F1 25's preset for this wheel may already use this control (EA publishes default wheel buttons only for the Logitech G923).

assignments.label: MFD / black box up
assignments.native: MFD + MFD Menu Up/Down/Left/Right; panel shortcuts (Car Setup, Pit Setup, Damage, Engine State, Temperature)
assignments.reason: MFD on Menu stick: F1 25 uses the D-pad for its MFD pages, so the stick that sends the D-pad suits it.
warnings: F1 25's preset for this wheel may already use this control (EA publishes default wheel buttons only for the Logitech G923).

assignments.label: DRS / active aero
assignments.native: Activate/Deactivate DRS/S Mode (2026 cars: Active Aero Corner <-> Straight Line Mode)
assignments.reason: DRS / active aero on Square: you use it often, so it's under your thumb.
conditions: 2026 cars: Active Aero Straight Line Mode, only in zones; the game returns to Corner Mode when you turn, brake or lift
warnings: F1 25's preset for this wheel may already use this control (EA publishes default wheel buttons only for the Logitech G923).

assignments.label: Overtake / boost
assignments.reason: Overtake / boost on Circle: you need it at a precise moment, so it's under your thumb.
conditions: 2026 cars: Overtake Mode once unlocked at the Detection Line
warnings: F1 25's preset for this wheel may already use this control (EA publishes default wheel buttons only for the Logitech G923).

assignments.pitwall_sees: CarStatus.m_pitLimiterStatus (in the spec, not mapped yet)

pitwall_ptt.text: Hold Triangle to talk to Pitwall: map it to UDP Action 1 in F1 25 (Controls > your wheel's preset > UDP Custom Actions).

not_on_wheel.label: Traction control
not_on_wheel.text: In F1 25, traction control and ABS are assists you set in the menu, not while driving.

not_on_wheel.label: ABS
not_on_wheel.text: In F1 25, traction control and ABS are assists you set in the menu, not while driving.

not_on_wheel.label: Wing
not_on_wheel.text: Wing angles are a setup item in every game researched. F1 25 2026 cars switch Active Aero to Straight Line Mode on the DRS/S Mode button inside the zones only; other games have DRS on cars that have it.

not_on_wheel.label: Ride height / weight jacker
not_on_wheel.text: No game Pitwall knows lets you change ride height while driving. F1 25 and GT7 only show it in the car setup; iRacing's weight jacker on some oval cars is the closest thing.

not_in_game.label: Lights
not_in_game.text: F1 25 has no light, wiper or ignition controls.
